scripts.build:packages: bun run build:runtime && bun run build:plugin
scripts.preflight:
cargo watch --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo '
error: cargo-watch is not installed (the dev scripts use it to restart the app on rebuilds).
Install it with:

    cargo install cargo-watch
' && exit 1)
scripts.dev:kanban: bun run preflight && bun --filter kanban build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names 'vite,cargo' --prefix-colors 'cyan,yellow' 'bun --filter kanban watch' 'cargo watch -w examples/kanban/dist -d 0.5 -x "run -p kanban"'
scripts.dev:calculator: bun run preflight && bun --filter calculator build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names 'vite,cargo' --prefix-colors 'cyan,yellow' 'bun --filter calculator watch' 'cargo watch -w examples/calculator/dist -d 0.5 -x "run -p calculator"'
scripts.dev:todo: bun run preflight && bun --filter todo build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names 'vite,cargo' --prefix-colors 'cyan,yellow' 'bun --filter todo watch' 'cargo watch -w examples/todo/dist -d 0.5 -x "run -p todo"'
